text:
akira: Calling out postmortem for last night's Region-A latency spike. Summary: KV cache thrash + autoscaler spike led to increased p95/p99 for ~45m. Proposing an action grid for owners, timelines, and SLO handling.

devon: Thanks — agree on owners. We need a dashboard owner and an error‑budget policy. I propose a temporary internal SLO window rather than user‑facing relax.

sam: Quick question — can we avoid relaxing public SLOs? I prefer faster failover (circuit breaker) + canary on the runtime change.

maria: From the metrics side: this looks recurrent around 03:00 UTC and correlates with nightly compaction jobs. Recommend ingestion backoff + alert on compaction latency > 2s.

jeff: I can own the compaction backoff and the immediate mitigation steps. ETA: EOD tomorrow for a PR + runbook entry.

akira: Great — need a dashboard owner too. @devon do you want dashboard + error budget policy?

devon: I can take it. Will create a dashboard with p50/p95/p99, request rate, queue length, KV cache hit ratio, and a synthetic probe for the 03:00 window. First draft by Wednesday.

sre-bot: Incident created: INC-2024-8425. Action items assigned: jeff(compaction_backoff), devon(dashboard_and_policy), sam(canary_plan).

sam: For the canary plan: propose 10% traffic for 6h with automatic rollback if p95 > 20% from baseline. I'll post config snippet below.

sam: snippet:
```
canary:
  traffic_split: 0.1
  duration: 6h
  rollback_on:
    - metric: p95_latency
      threshold_pct: 20
```

maria: Also suggest adding a recurring playbook task to review compaction timings weekly; assign to infra‑oncall rotation.

jeff: Runbook draft uploaded (placeholder): https://confluence/reviews/compaction-backoff — timeline: deploy backoff -> monitor 48h -> escalate if >10% error‑budget consumption.

akira: Concrete SLO handling proposal: keep production SLO values but create a temporary internal alert window with looser thresholds for 7 days while the patch lands and stabilizes. After 7 days run a post‑deploy review and decide on any public SLO changes. Anyone object?

devon: Fine. I'll own the post‑deploy review and the dashboard updates.

maria: No objections. Adding myself as secondary dashboard owner and will add the compaction >2s page alert.

akira: Thanks all. I'll update the postmortem with owners and timelines. Closing loop: Jeff — EOD tomorrow; Devon — dashboard by Wed; Sam — canary config by Thu; Post‑deploy review next Monday. :thumbsup:
